description:
Xishuangbanna is one of the most fascinating regions in China. Bordering both Laos and Myanmar, it is home to incredible ethnic and cultural diversity. The largest ethnic group here is the Dai people, whose language and culture are closely related to those of Thailand and other Tai peoples across Southeast Asia. Their traditional script even shares similarities with modern Thai and Burmese writing systems.
From tropical rainforests and Buddhist temples to unique local cuisine and vibrant traditions, Xishuangbanna feels unlike anywhere else in China.
Join me for this adventure at the China-Laos-Myanmar border 🎬
